added_lines: Sunday, 22nd November, 2026 – Feast of Our Lord Jesus Christ, King of the Universe WEB STREAMING OF MASS CAN BE FOUND AT

OF PARISHES On Saturday, 5th December, 2026 there will be a Coffee Morning in the rectory from 10:30am-1pm. Stalls, jams, cakes & raffle on the day. All are welcome. OWNING ICA The Annual ICA Cake Sale and Raffle takes place in the Marian Hall, Owning this Sunday, 22nd November, 2026 after 10am Mass. Proceeds will be used towards the Annual ICA Senior Citizens Dinner. Your support would be appreciated! PILTOWN KARATE CLUB would like to congratulate Breandán Twohig on his success in the recent World Championships in Turkey. Breandan came 4th in his Kata Category just pipped for a Bronze Medal and he got through 3 rounds of his Kumite (Sparring) category, which was a great achievement at such a high level of competition. Well done Breandán. CARERS IRELAND INFORMATION CLINIC Supporting Carers in Carrick-on-Suir and Piltown. Every Friday morning from 11am to 12.30pm in the Nano Nagle Community Resource Centre, Carrick- on-Suir. What to expect: 1. Getting to know each other. 2. Learn about the range of services and supports available from Family Carers Ireland. 3. A safe and welcoming space to share and be heard. More information: (052) 7447101 CHRISTMAS CAROL SERVICE The Annual Christmas Carol service will take place in Piltown Church on Thursday, December 10th. Anyone interested in joining the entertainers on the night, please contact Noel on

. PILTOWN ALL STAR-15 RESULTS Draw No. 9: 1st €1,000 Emer O Brien ; 2nd €500 Karen O Brien; 3rd €250 Marie Fitzgerald. 4th €100 Maura Birchill : 5th €100 Josie O Gorman . NOVEMBER STATIONS are no due. We appreciate your continued support of our Parish. Thank You! SERVICE OF LIGHT Thanks to all who turned out for the Service of Light on Friday night last to remember all those who died in our parish, but especially those who died in the last twelve months. It was a very special night in our parish. KILMACOW CHRISTMAS MARKET Date: 13th December, 2026. Time: 11am to 4pm. Venue: The Marian Hall, Strangsmills, Kilmacow (next door to Strangsmills School). Come join us for a day of Community fun! Free Arts and Crafts; Free Tea & Coffee; Free Parking; Jumbo raffle and cake sale. Live showcase by the Niamh Manning School of Irish Dancing from 12-1pm. Sing Along Carol Hour led by members of the Parish Choir from 1pm- 2pm. Autism Friendly Quiet half-hour from 3:30pm to 4pm. Loads of wonderful vendors with beautiful crafts for sale. Support local this Christmas! BINGO IS BACK AT OWNING HOUSE Bingo will re-commence at Owning House Retirement Village on Friday, November 27th. Eyes down at 7:30pm. Over 18’s only. All are Welcome. CHRISTMAS WREATH WORKSHOP Take some time out from your caring role to relax, get creative and enjoy the company of others. Together we will make beautiful Christmas wreaths and enjoy some festive fun! Friday, December 4th 11am to 1pm. Nano Nagle Centre, Carrick on Suir. CHRISTMAS CRAFT FAIR The Annual Christmas Craft Fair will take place on Sunday, November 22nd in Piltown Community Centre from 11am to 5pm. WE REMEMBER IN OUR PRAYERS AT THIS TIME people of the parish, those who have passed away in our community, our beloved family members & friends and all those who need our prayers at this time.
